name: Lua
source: A smart criminal who has knowledge of forbidden magic and makes experimental (usually deadly) potions on any subject he can find.[spoiler] He is also a "cleaner", murderer, blackmails people and collects body parts and organs for his experiments.[/spoiler] Lua "helped" [url=/c97699]Thiu[/url] with his social anxiety and depression by spliting his personality (and body) in two, creating the other [url=/c97702]Thiu[/url].
